Summary.Name: EchoAlign (research use only)
Summary.Description: Echocardiography vision-language foundation model that aligns each cardiac structure, video and study with report text. PACS-AI runs the authors' released linear probes (53 tasks: aortic stenosis detection and grade, AV peak velocity and gradients, LVEF, regurgitation detection and grades, chamber size, and others) on the study embedding. RESEARCH USE ONLY (CC BY-NC 4.0): not for diagnosis or treatment.
Summary.Developed_by: Ahmed Aly, Darya Taratynova, Lotfi Abdelkrim Mecharbat, Roman A. Sandler, Joseph Z. Sokol, Joshua Penn, Klaus H. Maier-Hein, Numan Saeed, Mohammad Yaqub (MBZUAI BioMedIA, iCardio.ai, DKFZ)

Mechanism.Outcome: 53 echo findings and measurements (released probes) plus zero-shot prompt scores
Mechanism.Output: Per-study probabilities, grades and measurements; per-clip AS, AV Vmax and EF
Mechanism.Time_of_prediction: On demand only (not run by automatic ingestion)
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Transthoracic echo DICOM clips: every multi-frame US instance by default (the same clips PanEcho receives); TEE and non-image instances are skipped. No view classifier.
Mechanism.Training_data_location_and_time-period: 2.87 million echo videos and images from 159 centres (telecardiology; test data from iCardio.ai). Probes fitted on the developers' private cohort.
Mechanism.Model_type: Vision-language foundation model with linear probes

Validation_and_performance: Developers (arXiv:2611.27517): mean AUROC 0.890 over 68 classification tasks and mean QWK 0.530 over 31 grading tasks (linear probes); AS (>= moderate) probe AUROC 0.979 private / 0.841 MIMIC-IV-Echo (EchoPrime 0.984 / 0.912).

MHI local check (54 TTE studies, SR truth, nothing fitted): severe AS AUROC 0.94 (95% CI 0.83-1.00), same as PanEcho 0.94; any AS 0.95 vs 0.95; LVEF<40 0.96 vs 0.96. The severe grade was never called (0/5 severe AS, including 4 TAVI patients); released grade >= moderate flagged 3/5 severe at specificity 48/49. AV Vmax estimate compressed (slope 0.12; severe AS predicted about 2.9 m/s).

Uses_and_directions.Benefits: Research comparison with PanEcho and other echo models.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Research evaluation by authorized researchers only.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Read the research-use banner. Results are visible only to OWNER/ADMIN and to roles that list EchoAlign explicitly.

Warnings_and_limitations.Risks: Research use only, not for diagnosis or treatment (CC BY-NC 4.0 and the developers' model card). Not calibrated on MHI: severe AS is not called and AV peak velocity/gradients are compressed toward the middle because spectral Doppler is not an input.
Warnings_and_limitations.Inappropriate_settings: Clinical decisions of any kind; commercial use; TEE; pediatric or congenital echo.
Warnings_and_limitations.Inappropriate_decision_support: Do not use for diagnosis, grading or treatment decisions.
Warnings_and_limitations.Generalizability: Probes and thresholds come from the developers' telecardiology cohort.

Other_information.Outcome_definition: See the released probe list in the model repository.

Changelogs.0.1.1: 2026-11-27: Security update: transformers 5.10.1 and pytest 9.0.3 (Dependabot #615). Outputs identical to 0.1.0 (max |diff| 0.0 on 1,215 clips of 14 MHI studies and on all prompt embeddings); TEE markers as PanEcho; 8-bit display conversion for high-bit-depth and MONOCHROME1 clips.
Changelogs.0.1.2: 2026-11-27: /inference/render-report, so the viewer shows the HTML report (research-use banner first) for stored results. Predictions unchanged.
